runs.emptyBody: Once you export an agent to CI, every automated review shows up here.
runs.title: CI Runs
runs.subtitle: Agent reviews executed inside CI · not local runs
runs.historyEmpty: No CI runs for this agent yet.

exportWizard.title: Export to CI
exportWizard.subtitle: Run {agentName} automatically on pull requests
exportWizard.repoHint: owner/name — the repo to add the workflow to
exportWizard.blockMergeDesc: Requires a GitHub App — not available with PAT in local mode
exportWizard.installCardTitle: Open a PR with these files
exportWizard.installCardBody: DevDigest opens a PR in {repo} titled “Add DevDigest CI review” with the {count} generated files.
exportWizard.secretNote: Add {key} to the repo's Actions secrets before the workflow runs.
exportWizard.existingNotice: {agent} is already installed in this repository. Installing will switch the repository's CI review to this agent.
exportWizard.editsReset: Manual edits to the workflow were reset because the configuration changed.
exportWizard.mergeHint: Blocking merges needs Fail CI on (CI tab) plus a required status check in branch protection.
exportWizard.installPr: Open a PR with these files
exportWizard.installPrBody: DevDigest opens a PR in {repo} titled “Add DevDigest CI review” with the {count} generated files.
exportWizard.installZipBody: Download the files and add them to {repo} yourself.
exportWizard.doneBody: The CI configuration for {repo} was created.

errors.no_token: No GitHub token is configured. Add one in Settings, or download the zip.
errors.forbidden: GitHub refused the write. The token needs write access to this repository — for a fine-grained token: Contents, Pull requests and Workflows set to Read and write. Or download the zip.
errors.missing_workflow_scope: The GitHub token lacks the workflow scope. Update the token, or download the zip.
errors.upstream_unavailable: GitHub is unavailable. Try again, or download the zip.
errors.runner_bundle_missing: The runner bundle is not built on the server.

ciTab.heading: CI deployment
ciTab.subtitle: Run this agent automatically on pull requests in a target repo.
ciTab.activeIn: Active in {count, plural, one {# repo} other {# repos}}
ciTab.empty: Not deployed to CI yet. Use “Add to CI” to open a PR that adds the workflow and agent config.
ciTab.failOnHint: Saving changes the agent only; use Update CI config to republish.

publishDialog.title: Publish to CI
publishDialog.subtitle: Run {agentName} on every pull request in {repo}
publishDialog.intro: Opens a pull request in {repo} adding a GitHub Actions workflow + this agent's config under .devdigest/. On every PR the agent reviews the diff.
publishDialog.secretNote: Add {key} to the repo's Actions secrets before the workflow runs. GITHUB_TOKEN is provided automatically.
publishDialog.doneBody: Opened/updated a pull request in {repo} with the workflow + agent config.
